description: BSD left side shown, right side hidden. DI_AEC_BSD_Show runs because sta_vehicleConditionShow != RET_SHOW and adasSwitch==1; bsdLeft==1 maps to sta_bsdLeftShow=RET_SHOW, bsdRight==0 maps to sta_bsdRightShow=RET_SHOW_NOT. Draw shows only the left image, right image hidden.

can.desc: ADAS fusion master switch ON, context gate

mem.desc: bsdLeft=1 is RET_SHOW -> left BSD drawn
bsdRight=0 is RET_SHOW_NOT -> right BSD hidden
vehicleConditionShow != RET_SHOW, gate lets BSD pass
